authoritative_t0_definition.sites_target_semantics: Period-ending hourly averages. H1 (00:00:00 UTC) represents 10-minute average over 23:00-00:00 UTC.

causal_availability_inventory.valid_time_relationship: Past 24h relative to t0 (00:00 UTC D-1 to 00:00 UTC Day D)

causal_availability_inventory.availability_relationship: T_pub = 21:30 UTC D-1 <= t0 (2.5h causal margin)

abis_causality_precision.product: E-GVAP COST-716 NRT Tropospheric Delay Product
abis_causality_precision.scientific_definition: GNSS-derived zenith total delay (ZTD), used as an independent observation-derived atmospheric feature.

rules_for_future_experiments.control_model: Stage 8.19 ABIS GNSS Model (42 features, MAE = 34.821405 W/m2)
rules_for_future_experiments.odd_access_rule: ODD is locked and untouchable for all future development; access authorized ONLY in dedicated evaluation stage after pre-ODD freeze.
rules_for_future_experiments.causal_governance_rule: All candidate features must prove T_pub <= t0 before EVEN CV evaluation (t0 = 00:00:00 UTC Day D).

second_governance_lock.rule_name: Second Governance Lock — No Feature Grinding
second_governance_lock.rule_text: Future research must prioritize genuinely independent information sources. Prohibited: algebraic transformations of existing features, spatial differentiation of existing NWP fields without strong justification, repackaging disagreement signals, arbitrary neighboring grid statistics, or redundant complexity.

scientific_language_guardrails.allowed_statement: All features used by the frozen Stage 8.19 model were verified against the authoritative benchmark t0 convention (t0 = 00:00:00 UTC Day D), with data availability/publication time no later than t0. Under the locked POLARIS benchmark and governance protocol, the frozen Stage 8.19 ABIS GNSS candidate improved the held-out ODD benchmark relative to Stage 8.17A.
prohibited_statements: ABIS proves GNSS is universally useful for solar forecasting
ZTD directly measures cloud liquid water content
All GNSS observations are spatially representative of mountain summits
The improvement is guaranteed to generalize to all polar stations
The remaining forecasting error is physically irreducible
